# Moving-price momentum

*Trades momentum in the moving price.*

**Kind** strategy · **Resolution** 15m

The opposite view to the discount strategy: buy when the pool price moves above the protocol's moving price with
momentum.

**Entry.** The close crosses above the moving price while it is also above an EMA of the close.

**Exit.** The close crosses back below the moving price, or falls more than *Min premium %* below it.

**What to try.** Run it next to *Moving-price discount* on the same subnet: one tends to work when the other does not.

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd>, open **Strategies** and choose **Moving-price momentum**. Or copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor and click **Add to chart**.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Momentum EMA | int | `20` |
| Min premium % | float | `1` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/examples/moving_price_momentum.as.js`.

```js
strategy({ name: "Moving-price momentum", version: "0.1", market: "ALPHA:61", resolution: "15m",
           capital: { tao: 100 }, actOn: "confirmed", risk: { maxPriceImpactPct: 0.5, maxDrawdownPct: 25 } });

const emaLen  = input.int("Momentum EMA", 20, { min: 3, max: 200 });
const premium = input.float("Min premium %", 1, { min: 0, max: 20, step: 0.25 });

const mp   = candle.movingPrice;
const ema  = ta.ema(candle.close, emaLen);
const prem = ta.change(candle.close, 0);
const above = ta.crossover(candle.close, mp);
const below = ta.crossunder(candle.close, mp);

plot(mp,  { title: "moving price", color: "#f2b544", style: "step" });
plot(ema, { title: "EMA", color: "#8b98a8" });
plotShape(above, { shape: "circle", location: "belowBar", color: "#2bb889", text: "↑mp" });

event.onCandle((bar) => {
  const pos = account.position();
  const premiumPct = (bar.close / mp.value - 1) * 100;
  if (pos.alpha === 0 && above.value && bar.close > ema.value && premiumPct >= 0)
    trade.buy({ tao: account.equity() * 0.5, maxPrice: pool.price() * 1.01, ttlBlocks: 3, reason: "spot>moving" });
  else if (pos.alpha > 0 && (below.value || premiumPct < -premium))
    trade.closePosition({ reason: below.value ? "spot<moving" : "premium-lost" });
});
```
